Story.Title: Europa. The Subsurface Expedition
Story.Plot: You are part of a deep-crust exploration team on Europa, Jupiter.s frozen moon. While returning from the "Pwyll" crater to the main base, your cryo-shuttle suffered a catastrophic engine failure and crashed. You are stranded on the surface, 100 kilometers from the primary habitat. Gravity is very low, about 13% of Earth's. The atmosphere is only a thin oxygen trace, essentially a vacuum. Temperatures are -160°C, and the surface is bombarded by Jupiter's lethal radiation. The terrain is made of jagged ridges of water-ice and deep crevasses.

Evaluations.Rank: Galilean Hero. You mastered the radiation and the ice.
Expert Explorer. You reached the habitat with minor radiation sickness.
Survivor. It was a brutal trip, but you are alive.
Frozen. You likely ran out of heat or oxygen halfway.
Stardust. You are now a permanent part of Europa's icy crust.

Item.Name: Pressurized Oxygen Cylinders
Item.Description: Fundamental. No oxygen = death in minutes.

Item.Name: Portable Fusion Core
Item.Description: At -160°C, your suit systems freeze instantly without constant heat.

Item.Name: Lead-Lined Thermal Ponchos
Item.Description: Jupiter's radiation is lethal. Shielding is non-negotiable.

Item.Name: High-Calorie Nutrient Paste
Item.Description: You need massive energy to move 100 km in 0.13g gravity.

Item.Name: Cryo-Ice Crampons
Item.Description: Without these, you will slide or fall on the slick, jagged ice.

Item.Name: Suit Sealant
Item.Description: Sharp ice tears suits. A leak = rapid decompression.

Item.Name: Electromagnetic Navigation Unit
Item.Description: Essential to track the base against the shifting ice crust.

Item.Name: Inflatable Pressurized Habitat
Item.Description: Necessary to cycle out of the suit and recover from radiation.

Item.Name: Medical Trauma Kit
Item.Description: Anti-rad meds and surgical tools for suit injuries.

Item.Name: 30m Monofilament Winch
Item.Description: Critical for crossing deep, impassable crevasses.

Item.Name: Aqueous Ice-Melter
Item.Description: Useful to fuse ice for bridges or smooth paths.

Item.Name: Short-Wave Radio Transmitter
Item.Description: Only works in line-of-sight. Good, but range is very limited.

Item.Name: Spare 20-Liter Water Container
Item.Description: Heavy and useless. You are walking on billions of tons of water-ice. Melt it as you go.

Item.Name: Physical Paper Maps
Item.Description: Useless. Europas surface shifts constantly; ice-quakes make paper maps obsolete.

Item.Name: Cigarette Lighter
Item.Description: Useless. No atmospheric oxygen to sustain a flame and too cold to ignite.
